Independent security review of the TASK-015 diff: 0 CRITICAL, 3 MEDIUM, 2 LOW, all MEDIUM/LOW fixed with regression tests and re-verified against the reviewer's own reproductions. (1) Predictable temp filename + symlink-following writes let a pre-planted symlink redirect a catalog write outside the registry dir — fixed with mkstemp and an O_CREAT|O_EXCL exclusive-create backup. (2) doctor/status/route crashed with a traceback (exit 1) on a non-mapping YAML root or non-UTF-8 bytes — fixed with a typed CatalogError + registry._load_yaml UnicodeDecodeError catch; all three now fail cleanly with exit 3. (3) Backup rotation used 1-second granularity and overwrote history when two rollbacks landed in the same second — fixed with a nanosecond key + collision probe (5 rapid cycles now keep 5 backups). LOW: provider-id allowlist for rollback/restore; control characters stripped from provenance before display.

Now branch-aware: add/commit only on task/* branches; push only from a task/* branch for that same branch, never forced, never targeting a protected branch.
